name: localcoffeeshop-frontend
description: Frontend for Local Coffee Shop directory

scripts.build: npm run build:config && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:js: mkdir -p public/dist && npx terser public/frontend.js -o public/dist/app.min.js -c -m && npx terser public/constants.js -o public/dist/constants.min.js -c -m && npx terser public/html/state.js -o public/dist/state.min.js -c -m
scripts.build:css: npx clean-css-cli -o public/dist/styles.min.css styles.css public/styles/about.css public/styles/common.css public/styles/features.css public/styles/home.css public/styles/states.css
